prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: landscape 3:2 premium website product still life.
Create a polished studio still life containing exactly FOUR actual original landscape rectangular Kiddo OAT BISCUITS boxes, using the four supplied references as strict visual identity sources. Reference 1 chocolate is dark brown; reference 2 apple cinnamon is green; reference 3 honey is golden yellow/amber; reference 4 coconut is turquoise/blue. Preserve their wide horizontal landscape box shapes, red upper-left panel with white handwritten Kiddo logo, original OAT BISCUITS English and Arabic title placement, original food artwork and original color identities. Keep authentic package graphics and labels, no invented packages, flavors, nutrition, health facts or claims.
Arrange the four boxes on a white table with low clean white and red display risers, two slightly behind and two slightly forward, all four fronts readable and entirely visible. Lay delicious real oat biscuits in front: golden oat biscuits and chocolate oat biscuits, one broken biscuit to show crumb. Minimal appetizing product scene with a white backdrop and a red backdrop accent. Nearly frontal slightly elevated camera, soft premium studio lighting, rich biscuit texture, natural shadows, balanced composition and uncluttered margins. Supporting palette red and white with source package colors unchanged. No webpage, UI, buttons, headings, captions, floating words, watermark or text outside original package graphics.
